title: IPGD in Human Resource Management (Level 7)
description: Equip yourself with advanced skills in human resource management aligned with global practices.
longDescription: The IPGD in Human Resource Management (Level 7) is designed to develop advanced-level knowledge and practical expertise in managing people and organizational growth. Learners gain insights into strategic HR planning, performance enhancement, and employment law within a global framework. The course supports the development of leadership and talent management capabilities for dynamic, multicultural workplaces. It prepares learners to contribute to the long-term sustainability and competitive advantage of organizations. The Programme offers an efficient approach beyond traditional classroom learning. The course emphasises real-world applications through case studies, business simulations, and 100% project-based learning, allowing participants to practice what they learn in a controlled environment before applying it to their roles. The International Postgraduate Diploma (IPGD) in Human Resource Management allows you to achieve the qualification in 9 months. It is a fast track to new opportunities and enhanced career prospects. The curriculum combines theory and practice to equip learners with the skills to address complex operational challenges and deliver strategic solutions in human resource management.
courseDetails: The programme integrates theoretical knowledge with real-world application, focusing on core areas like employee engagement, global talent sourcing, and performance leadership. Emphasis is placed on critical thinking, analytical research, and data-driven decision-making to support strategic HR outcomes. Learners will engage with contemporary HR issues, including digital transformation, ethical labour practices, and evolving legal standards. By completing this course, students become equipped to lead high-impact HR initiatives in diverse business environments. Course Details: Business Research Methods: This module explores advanced research methodologies used in HR and management. Students learn to design, execute, and evaluate research projects that inform evidence-based HR practices. Engagement of Employees and Organisational Learning: Focuses on the psychological and structural drivers of employee engagement and lifelong learning. It examines techniques for building resilient, adaptive, and high-performing organizations. Global Resourcing Talents and Reward Management: Examines strategies for attracting, retaining, and rewarding talent in a competitive global market. Topics include workforce planning, compensation systems, and ethical recruitment practices. Leadership Development and Performance Management: Explores the integration of leadership development with performance systems to enhance individual and organizational outcomes. It includes succession planning, coaching, and feedback models. Managing Employment Relations and Employment Law: Covers the legal and strategic aspects of employment relationships, including contracts, dispute resolution, and labor rights. Emphasis is placed on compliance and risk mitigation. Strategic Human Resource Management: Enables learners to align HR strategy with business goals to support innovation and competitive advantage. The module covers workforce analytics, strategic planning, and change management. Assessment: Graduation Project (GP) Upon finishing the coursework, students must complete a graduation project (GP) that combines and utilises the knowledge acquired across different modules. This qualification embodies current practices in Human Resource Management and helps learners deepen and broaden their understanding of the field at an advanced level. Programme Structure and Credits: This programme comprises 6 modules with 30 ECTS and 1 GP of 30 ECTS.

entry: An honours degree in a related subject or the UK level 6 diploma or equivalent overseas qualification, i.e. Bachelors Degree or Higher National Diploma.
Mature learners (over 25) with at least five years of management experience if they do not possess the above qualification (this is reviewed on a case-by-case basis).

accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: University Top-up On completion of this course, students have the opportunity to complete a Master degree programme from Partner University. The top-up programme can be studied online or on campus. The top-up comprises the final 60 credits which consist of either a dissertation or a dissertation and one module. (The course tuition fee listed above does NOT include the top-up fee) University Progression Click here to see University routes and fee information for progression.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

modules.title: ENGAGEMENT OF EMPLOYEES AND ORGANISATIONAL LEARNING
modules.summary: The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of contemporary issues in the Engagement of Employees, Organisational Learning, people management, and development. Learners will examine and critically evaluate the purpose and objectives of human resource management, and design and implementation of HR action plans for promoting employee engagement and organizational performance.

modules.title: GLOBAL RESOURCING, TALENT AND REWARD MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: Module Aim The aim of this unit is to develop learners’ understanding of the principles and practices of resourcing, Global talent management, performance and reward management in corporate contexts. Learners will acquire both theoretical and practical understanding of recruitment, selection, employee retention and dismissal and related aspects of Global talent management. The learners will also learn the diverse approaches to effective reward and performance management in the global context.
